Rahul Gandhi’s acquittal in a defamation case, the INDIA bloc’s November 1 ‘Vote Chori’ rally, Congress–Samajwadi Party tensions and the BJP’s ‘foreign hand’ narrative have brought the opposition’s strategy into focus. Who holds the narrative advantage, and what could this mean for the 2027 Assembly elections?
